researchGaps: Finite prior production passes have ended. The recovered ophthalmic-genetics fellowship has a source-cited curriculum and syllabus. Further generation requires fresh source checks; no content completion or clinical validation is inferred.

Browser review recovered the MGB dynamic directory: direct public Fellowship and Residency links rendered 300 Fellowship cards and 65 Residency cards (63 unique residency URLs; two duplicate optometry cards). The source is overinclusive: it also labels psychology, pharmacy, optometry, dental, undergraduate, research and administrative offerings as training. Those are not silently converted into physician clinical programmes.

MGB central results do not provide a hospital-only filter or a reliable public machine-readable export. The review paginated all current Fellowship and Residency result cards in the browser, but central MGB coverage cannot be represented as an assertion that every card belongs to an HMS affiliate or is a physician programme.

Brigham’s public Residents and Fellows page says it hosts more than 140 programmes but points to a legacy partners.org directory. The current MGB dynamic directory is the usable public index; internal SharePoint materials for program development and some trainee resources require MGB login and were not accessed.

Mass Eye and Ear is now enumerated through official HMS Ophthalmology and Otolaryngology directories plus current MGB programme cards. The HMS Ophthalmology page names Boston Children/MEE ophthalmic genetics and pediatric vitreoretinal/ocular-oncology offerings but does not expose each programme-level URL; no URL was invented.
Harvard Pilgrim Health Care Institute/Harvard Pilgrim public site presents insurance-member and provider resources, not a physician GME directory. No clinical residency/fellowship was added.

Judge Baker Children’s Center public directory verification remains inaccessible in this environment (the queried hostname did not resolve through stateless extraction); no physician programme was inferred.

Schepens Eye Research Institute is represented in HMS affiliation but its accessible MEE material is research-oriented; no independent clinical physician GME directory was found. Research-only positions remain excluded.

McLean’s psychology postdoctoral listings, MGB pharmacy/optometry/dental/physical-therapy residencies, student clerkships, undergraduate programmes, administrative fellowships, and research-only fellowships were retained as exclusion evidence in the browser harvest rather than added as clinical physician programmes.

VA Boston’s public trainee page includes a physician Behavioral Neurology/Neuropsychiatry/Geriatric Neurology fellowship and the Harvard/Spaulding/MGB SCI programme, both matched to existing items. Its page also mixes many non-physician programmes; no inferred VA roster was created.
